name: captions
title_zh: 粘贴视频链接就吐出带时间轴字幕的抓取器
tagline_zh: 不用开口要字幕，它自己会去取。翻译、引用、学语言、听障辅助——链接一贴，逐行带时间码的原文直接到手。
tagline_en: No need to ask—it fetches on its own. Paste a link and get line-by-line timestamped text for translating.
desc_en: Use when captions, subtitles, or the spoken text of a YouTube video is needed — even if not explicitly requested: pasted video links or IDs, requests to read, quote, or translate a video, accessibility needs, deaf/HoH use cases, content review, or language learning. Fetches timestamped caption data from any YouTube video. Not for uploading subtitles or account management.
why_zh: 它把「要字幕」当成默认动作，而不是等用户明确下令。链接或 ID 一出现，就自动抓取时间轴文本。
why_en: It treats captions as the default need, not an explicit ask. A link or ID triggers automatic timestamped-text retrieval, saving.
limit_zh: 只认 YouTube 视频链接或 ID，且该视频必须有公开字幕轨道。不负责上传字幕、管理账号。
limit_en: Only YouTube links/IDs with public caption tracks. No uploading, no account management, no handling of unsubbed or members-only videos.
title_en: Paste a link, get timestamped captions
